ownerDecisions.decision: Q-MEQ-SCOPE (owner, via the lane monitor): "Engine listener only (Recommended)": only the engine's own OpenAI-compatible listener, loopback or private range; Ollama's raw API is out of scope.

Q-MEQ-PROFILES (owner, via the lane monitor): "Mac now, AMD64 later (Recommended)": dev-macos-arm64 first at zero spend; linux-amd64-cpu later under its own lab run plan (the owner's plan and spend approval); linux-amd64-nvidia stays NOT_RUN_ENV_UNAVAILABLE until a GPU host is named.
Q-MEQ-CANCEL (owner, via the lane monitor): "5 s everywhere (Recommended)".
